predicates.name: booking_user_id_known
predicates.description: The booking user's ID has been stated by the user or returned by an earlier tool call.

predicates.name: booking_trip_details_known
predicates.description: The trip type, origin, and destination for the pending reservation have been stated by the user or returned by an earlier tool call.

predicates.name: reservation_has_at_most_five_passengers
predicates.description: The pending reservation arguments contain no more than five passengers.

predicates.name: every_passenger_has_required_identity_details
predicates.description: Every passenger in the pending reservation arguments has a first name, last name, and date of birth.

predicates.name: all_passengers_share_flights_and_cabin
predicates.description: The passengers in the pending reservation arguments are assigned the same flights and cabin.

predicates.name: booking_payment_method_limits_respected
predicates.description: The pending reservation arguments use no more than one travel certificate, one credit card, and three gift cards.

predicates.name: booking_payment_methods_are_in_user_profile
predicates.description: Every payment method in the pending reservation arguments is present in the user's profile according to an earlier tool result.

predicates.name: baggage_counts_match_member_allowance
predicates.description: The pending baggage totals and nonfree baggage count match the free allowance calculated for the passenger count, cabin, and user membership tier: regular members receive 0, 1, or 2 free bags per passenger for basic economy, economy, or business; silver members receive 1, 2, or 3; gold members receive 2, 3, or 3; any bags beyond the total free allowance are counted as nonfree.

predicates.name: travel_insurance_choice_was_requested
predicates.description: Before the pending booking action, the agent asked the user whether they wanted to buy travel insurance.

predicates.name: pending_booking_change_details_were_listed
predicates.description: Before the pending database update, the agent listed the details of that specific booking or reservation change, matching the pending action arguments.

predicates.name: user_explicitly_confirmed_pending_change_after_details
predicates.description: After the agent listed the details matching the pending database update, the user explicitly replied yes to proceeding with that change.

predicates.name: reservation_id_known
predicates.description: The reservation ID has been stated by the user or returned by an earlier tool call.

predicates.name: reservation_is_basic_economy
predicates.description: An earlier tool result identifies the reservation as basic economy.

predicates.name: reservation_flight_itinerary_unchanged
predicates.description: The flights and itinerary in the pending flight-update arguments match the reservation's flights and itinerary in an earlier tool result.

predicates.name: reservation_origin_destination_and_trip_type_unchanged
predicates.description: The pending flight-update arguments preserve the reservation's original origin, destination, and trip type, as shown by an earlier tool result.

predicates.name: all_updated_flight_segments_use_one_cabin
predicates.description: All flight segments in the pending flight-update arguments use the same cabin class.

predicates.name: user_id_known
predicates.description: The user ID has been stated by the user or returned by an earlier tool call.

predicates.name: reservation_baggage_is_not_reduced
predicates.description: The pending baggage-update arguments do not reduce the reservation's total checked baggage compared with an earlier tool result.

predicates.name: reservation_passenger_count_is_unchanged
predicates.description: The pending passenger-update arguments contain the same number of passengers as the reservation in an earlier tool result.

predicates.name: flight_change_payment_method_is_user_provided_credit_or_gift_card
predicates.description: The pending flight-update payment ID corresponds to one credit card or gift card the user provided as the payment or refund method.

predicates.name: agent_asked_for_payment_or_refund_method
predicates.description: Before the pending flight update, the agent asked the user for a payment or refund method.

predicates.name: cancellation_reason_is_known_and_valid
predicates.description: The user has provided a cancellation reason that is change of plan, airline-cancelled flight, or another reason.

predicates.name: reservation_was_booked_within_24_hours_of_policy_time
predicates.description: An earlier tool result gives a booking time no more than 24 hours before the current time stated in policy sentence S1.

predicates.name: airline_cancelled_the_reservation
predicates.description: The user stated, or an earlier tool result indicates, that the airline cancelled the reservation's flight.

predicates.name: reservation_is_business_cabin
predicates.description: An earlier tool result identifies the reservation as business cabin.

predicates.name: reservation_is_basic_or_economy_cabin
predicates.description: An earlier tool result identifies the reservation as basic economy or economy cabin.

predicates.name: reservation_has_travel_insurance
predicates.description: An earlier tool result indicates that the reservation has travel insurance.

predicates.name: cancellation_reason_is_health_or_weather
predicates.description: The user stated that the cancellation is needed for a health or weather reason.

predicates.name: no_reservation_segments_have_been_flown_or_used
predicates.description: An earlier tool result indicates that none of the reservation's flight segments have been flown or used.

predicates.name: request_is_outside_available_agent_scope
predicates.description: From the user's stated goal, available tools, and prior tool results, the requested outcome cannot be completed within the agent's permitted actions.

predicates.name: user_complained_about_cancelled_reservation_flights
predicates.description: The user complained about cancelled flights in a reservation.

predicates.name: user_complained_about_delayed_reservation_flights
predicates.description: The user complained about delayed flights in a reservation.

predicates.name: compensation_eligibility_criterion_met
predicates.description: Earlier tool results show that the user is silver or gold, or the reservation has travel insurance, or the reservation flies business cabin.

predicates.name: disruption_facts_were_confirmed_with_user
predicates.description: The agent stated the relevant cancelled-flight or delayed-flight facts to the user, those facts are supported by earlier tool results or user statements, and the user confirmed them.

predicates.name: certificate_amount_is_100_dollars_per_passenger
predicates.description: The pending certificate amount equals $100 multiplied by the reservation's passenger count shown in an earlier tool result.

predicates.name: user_wants_change_or_cancellation_due_to_delay
predicates.description: The user wants to change or cancel the reservation because of the complained-about flight delay.

predicates.name: reservation_change_or_cancellation_succeeded_before_certificate
predicates.description: An earlier tool result shows a successful change or cancellation of the reservation associated with the delayed-flight complaint.

predicates.name: certificate_amount_is_50_dollars_per_passenger
predicates.description: The pending certificate amount equals $50 multiplied by the reservation's passenger count shown in an earlier tool result.

predicates.name: user_explicitly_requested_compensation
predicates.description: The user explicitly asked for compensation for the complained-about situation.

predicates.name: user_is_regular_uninsured_and_flies_basic_or_economy
predicates.description: Earlier tool results show that the user is a regular member, the reservation has no travel insurance, and the reservation flies basic economy or economy.

rules.description: The booking user's ID must be known before booking.
The trip type, origin, and destination must be known before booking.
A reservation may contain no more than five passengers.
Each passenger must have the required identifying details.
All passengers must share the same flights and cabin.
The payment-method limits for a reservation must be respected.
All payment methods used for booking must already be in the user's profile.
Booking baggage counts must reflect the applicable membership allowance.
The agent must ask whether the user wants travel insurance before booking.
The booking details must be listed before the database update.
The user must explicitly confirm the listed booking details with yes.
The user ID and reservation ID must be known before modifying flights.
The flight-update details must be listed before the database update.
The user must explicitly confirm the listed flight-update details with yes.
The user ID and reservation ID must be known before modifying baggage.
The baggage-update details must be listed before the database update.
The user must explicitly confirm the listed baggage-update details with yes.
The user ID and reservation ID must be known before modifying passengers.
The passenger-update details must be listed before the database update.
The user must explicitly confirm the listed passenger-update details with yes.
Basic economy flights may not be changed, but a cabin-only update that leaves the itinerary unchanged is permitted.
A flight update must preserve the reservation's origin, destination, and trip type.
All flights in the reservation must use the same cabin class.
A baggage update may add bags but may not remove checked bags.
Updated baggage counts must reflect the applicable membership allowance.
Passenger information may be changed only while keeping the passenger count unchanged.
A flight change must use the one credit card or gift card provided by the user as a payment or refund method.
The agent must ask for the payment or refund method before updating flights.
The user ID, reservation ID, and a valid cancellation reason must be known before cancellation.

rules.condition: reservation_was_booked_within_24_hours_of_policy_time OR airline_cancelled_the_reservation OR reservation_is_business_cabin OR (reservation_is_basic_or_economy_cabin AND reservation_has_travel_insurance AND cancellation_reason_is_health_or_weather)
rules.description: Cancellation is permitted within 24 hours of booking, for an airline-cancelled flight, for business cabin, or for basic economy/economy with insurance and a qualifying health or weather reason; membership status does not affect eligibility.
Cancellation is permitted only for a whole trip with no segments already flown or used.
Transfer is permitted only when the request cannot be handled within the agent's available scope.

rules.condition: (user_complained_about_cancelled_reservation_flights AND compensation_eligibility_criterion_met AND disruption_facts_were_confirmed_with_user AND certificate_amount_is_100_dollars_per_passenger) OR (user_complained_about_delayed_reservation_flights AND user_wants_change_or_cancellation_due_to_delay AND compensation_eligibility_criterion_met AND disruption_facts_were_confirmed_with_user AND reservation_change_or_cancellation_succeeded_before_certificate AND certificate_amount_is_50_dollars_per_passenger)
rules.description: A certificate must fit one of the policy's cancelled-flight or delayed-flight gesture cases, including its eligibility, confirmation, completion, and amount requirements.
The user must explicitly ask for compensation before a certificate is sent as compensation.
No compensation certificate may be sent to a regular member with no insurance who flies basic economy or economy.

dispositions.reason: It supplies the current time used to evaluate the 24-hour cancellation window.
It describes the agent's general service scope.
Each booking database update requires listed details and explicit user confirmation.
Grounding, subjectivity, and general response quality cannot be checked as restrictions on one action.
Simultaneous tool calls and user responses cannot be checked one action at a time.
Combining a response and a tool call cannot be checked one action at a time.
A general obligation to refuse prohibited requests is not a checkable restriction on one action.
The transfer action is restricted to requests outside the available agent scope.
The required booking identifiers and trip details must be known before booking; the requested order of earlier questions cannot be checked.
The passenger limit is checked against the pending booking arguments.
Required passenger details are checked against the pending booking arguments.
Shared flights and cabin are checked against the pending booking arguments.
The payment-method limits are checked against the pending booking arguments.
It states the refund property of a travel certificate.
Booking payment methods are checked against the user's profile.
The regular-member baggage allowance is checked for booking and baggage updates.
The silver-member baggage allowance is checked for booking and baggage updates.
The gold-member baggage allowance is checked for booking and baggage updates.
The extra-baggage price is stated, but no available action argument exposes a price to check.
The agent must ask about travel insurance before booking.
Both identifiers must be known before each reservation modification.
Basic economy flight changes are blocked except for an unchanged itinerary.
Flight updates must preserve origin, destination, and trip type.
It describes how prices behave for retained segments.
The applicable flight-change restrictions are checked before the update action.
A cabin-only change with an unchanged itinerary is the exception to the basic-economy flight-change prohibition.
The available flight-update arguments do not expose the cabin price difference or whether that amount was paid.
The cabin class across updated flight segments is checked in the pending arguments.
The pending baggage total is compared with the current reservation.
No available action can add insurance after the initial booking.
The passenger count is compared with the current reservation.
It describes a limitation on human-agent assistance.
The pending flight update must use a user-provided credit card or gift card.
The agent must ask for a payment or refund method before the flight update.
The required identifiers and cancellation reason must be known before cancellation.
The 24-hour window and airline-cancellation exception are included in the cancellation eligibility condition.
The cabin, insurance, and qualifying-reason cancellation conditions are included.
The cancellation eligibility condition does not depend on membership status.
The cancellation eligibility restrictions are checked before cancellation.
Cancellation is blocked when any segment has already been flown or used.
A block-only guardrail cannot require the agent to initiate the needed transfer.
It states the refund destination and processing timeframe.
The cancelled-flight certificate case and its eligibility, confirmation, and amount conditions are checked.
The delayed-flight certificate case and its eligibility, confirmation, completion, and amount conditions are checked.
A compensation certificate requires an explicit user request for compensation.
The specified regular-member, uninsured, economy case is prohibited from receiving compensation.
